daily_balance.definition: Sum immutable posted journal lines through the current business date using the account normal side; available balance subtracts unreleased, unexpired holds. No model-generated balance formulas.
daily_balance.as_of: Institution business date from its configured timezone (Africa/Cairo initially), independent of client/session timezone, and statement timestamp; historical holds need their release/expiry timestamps.
daily_balance.currency_rule: Amounts remain in each account's ISO currency; never sum unlike currencies.

high_risk_cash.definition: Aggregate confirmed posted USD cash movements for each known conductor/beneficiary and business date. Deduplicate the same transaction/person. Cash-in and cash-out are separate totals; either strictly exceeding USD 10000 triggers review. Do not offset directions or accounts.
high_risk_cash.boundary: Monitoring evidence, not automatic CTR/SAR filing. Exemption adjudication, cross-currency valuation and ownership knowledge require approved additional evidence.

loan_performance.definition: Outstanding loan principal comes from posted loan-account ledger balance. Delinquency is days since the earliest unpaid contractual installment due before the business date. Daily interest is principal * contractual annual rate * contractual day-count fraction for [business_date, business_date + 1).
loan_performance.rounding: Retain calculation precision; round only at currency posting. Fixed-rate, simple-interest contracts in v1; no invented compounding, grace periods or variable-rate resets.
